Title: Internship/Master thesis (f/m/x) Quantum Machine Learning for Crashworthiness Optimization
Description:
The Institute of Vehicle Concepts (FK) of the German Aerospace Centre (DLR) is internationally recognized for the design of future road and rail vehicles that enable climate and environmentally friendly mobility while being affordable and user-friendly at the same time.

We research and demonstrate the required key technologies and maintain close cooperation with other scientific institutions as well as industrial and political bodies.

What To Expect

In crashworthiness optimization, we aim to design vehicles that are robust, safe, and lightweight. Evaluating these designs is computationally expensive, so we use surrogate models to approximate costly simulations. However, mathematical bottlenecks within the surrogate modeling process can limit efficiency and accuracy. In this Master’s thesis, you will explore how quantum algorithms can accelerate and enhance surrogate modeling, gaining hands-on experience with quantum machine learning methods, engaging with the latest literature, and contributing to cutting-edge research at the intersection of quantum computing and predictive modeling.

Your tasks


Conduct focused literature research in the areas of quantum algorithms and surrogate modeling
Implement quantum algorithms and develop quantum-enhanced surrogate models
Apply quantum machine learning models to benchmark functions and test their performance
Compare the performance of quantum models with classical approaches, analyzing strengths and limitations


Your profile


Ongoing scientific university studies in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, or a related field
Experience in optimization methods and techniques
Strong Python programming skills
Problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
Interest in quantum computing and machine learning
Curiosity and motivation to explore innovative computational methods
Experience with Gaussian Processes, GPyTorch, or PennyLane is a advantageous


We look forward to getting to know you!

Title: Trainee (m/w/d) Risk Control
Description:
Referenznummer: 17817 - Einsatzort: Stuttgart - Funktionsbereich: Risk Control - Organisationseinheit: Risk Control - Starttermin: 1. April 2027

Die LBBW zählt zu den führenden Banken Deutschlands und ist ein innovatives, internationales Unternehmen im Finanzsektor. Wir sind eine verlässliche Bank und wissen, was es heißt, sich zu verändern. Digitalisierung, Agilität und Effizienz sind für uns nicht nur Schlagworte, sondern ständige Begleiter unserer eigenen Entwicklung. Denn nur wer sich selbst wandelt, versteht, was es dafür braucht. Wir bieten ein Umfeld, das persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung fördert. Mit über 10.000 Mitarbeitenden gestalten wir die Zukunft der Finanzwelt – gemeinsam #NeuesSchaffen.

Informationen zum Einsatzbereich:

Dich reizt die Risikoüberwachung in der größten Landesbank Deutschlands? Für Dich sind Themen wie Data Analytics und Digitalisierung nicht nur Trendwörter, sondern echte Chance, etwas zu bewegen? Du möchtest Risiken nicht nur quantifizieren, sondern Deine Ergebnisse nutzen, um die Bank gemeinsam mit Deinem Team weiterzuentwickeln und stabile, zukunftsfähige Lösungen zu schaffen? Dann bewirb Dich für das Traineeprogramm im Risk Control der LBBW! Die Risiken der Gesamtbank immer im Blick: Du arbeitest aktiv an der Quantifizierung der unterschiedlichen Risikoarten mit und lernst deren Zusammenhänge kennen. Hier arbeitest Du an aktuellen Projekten, methodischen Fragestellungen und der Entwicklung von Bewertungs- und Risikomodellen mit. Dabei nutzt die LBBW die Chancen, die der digitale Wandel für die Finanzbranche bietet und stellt sich der Verantwortung für künftige Generationen.

Das 18-monatige Traineeprogramm geht gezielt auf Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und Wünsche ein und bereitet Dich als Potenzialträger:in auf Deine anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit nach dem Traineeprogramm vor. Die Inhalte werden in enger Abstimmung mit einer Führungskraft aus dem Fachbereich für Dich maßgeschneidert. Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, regelmäßiges Feedback und Raum, um Neues auszuprobieren. So kannst Du entdecken, wo Deine Stärken liegen – und diese im Team einbringen.

Deine Aufgaben:


Ab dem ersten Tag an übernimmst Du als vollwertiges Teammitglied die sukzessive, gut begleitete Verantwortung für ausgewählte Themenstellungen im Kredit- und Marktpreis-Risikocontrolling und der übergeordneten Risikosteuerung sowie der Überwachung neuer regulatorischer Anforderungen.
Gemeinsam mit dem Fachbereich überwachst Du die jeweiligen Risikoarten und trägst dazu bei, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Neben der quantitativen Modellvalidierung legst Du außerdem Wert auf ein angemessenes Managementreporting der diversen Risikoarten.Du bringst Dich aktiv ein und sorgst für einen umfassenden Wissenstransfer in der LBBW.
Auch in bereichs- und abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten zählen wir auf Deine aktive Mitarbeit und Unterstützung. Neben Einsätzen in den Handelseinheiten und im Treasury sind weitere Aufgaben und Schnittstellen mit dem Risikomanagement mögliche Teile Deiner Ausbildung.


Dein Profil:


Du hast ein Hochschulstudium der (Wirtschafts-)Mathematik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Physik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit quantitativem Schwerpunkt abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss. Im Auswahlprozess überzeugst Du mit einem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen kognitiven Leistungstest.
Über Praktika oder Werkstudierendentätigkeiten bist Du bereits in der Praxis mit dem Risikomanagement oder Risikocontrolling in der Finanzbranche in Berührung gekommen.
Du überzeugst in unserem internationalen Umfeld durch Deine sprachlichen und kommunikativen Fähigkeiten und kannst Dich sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch mindestens auf C1-Niveau verständigen.
Du bringst eine hohe IT-Affinität sowie Interesse am Lernen von Programmiersprachen mit. Deine ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeit sowie hohe Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnen Dich aus.
Im Arbeitsalltag suchst Du gerne gemeinsam im Team nach innovativen Lösungen und bringst eine Begeisterung für neue Entwicklungen (bspw. KI oder regulatorische Veränderungen) mit.

  • Gemeinsam mit dem Fachbereich überwachst Du die jeweiligen Risikoarten und trägst dazu bei, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Auch in bereichs- und abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten zählen wir auf Deine aktive Mitarbeit und Unterstützung. Neben Einsätzen in den Handelseinheiten und im Treasury sind weitere Aufgaben und Schnittstellen mit dem Risikomanagement mögliche Teile Deiner Ausbildung.

Dein Profil:

  • Du hast ein Hochschulstudium der (Wirtschafts-)Mathematik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Physik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit quantitativem Schwerpunkt abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss. Im Auswahlprozess überzeugst Du mit einem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen kognitiven Leistungstest.

  • Du bringst eine hohe IT-Affinität sowie Interesse am Lernen von Programmiersprachen mit. Deine ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeit sowie hohe Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnen Dich aus.
  • Im Arbeitsalltag suchst Du gerne gemeinsam im Team nach innovativen Lösungen und bringst eine Begeisterung für neue Entwicklungen (bspw. KI oder regulatorische Veränderungen) mit.

Title: Forward Deployed Engineer - FDE (w/m/x)
Description:
NTT DATA is a trusted global innovator of business and technology services, helping clients innovate, optimize, and transform for success. We strive to hire exceptional, innovative, and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

Overview

The Forward-Deployed Engineer is a client-facing builder within the AI GTM organization responsible for rapidly creating demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, and MVPs that make AI opportunities tangible for clients and account teams. This role combines hands-on engineering, AI fluency, product thinking, and field presence to translate client problems into working technical concepts using models, agents, data, workflows, integrations, and user experiences.

Key Responsibilities


Rapidly build demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, and MVPs that bring AI use cases to life for clients and account teams.
Translate client problems into working technical concepts using models, agents, data, workflows, APIs, integrations, and user experience patterns.
Support discovery workshops, executive demos, technical deep dives, proof-of-value sessions, and partner enablement activities.
Partner with Solution Architects to ensure prototypes align to scalable architecture, delivery paths, security expectations, and operational requirements.
Work with ecosystem partners to showcase differentiated capabilities across OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google/Gemini, cloud, data, and enterprise platforms.
Package prototypes into reusable assets, demo scripts, technical collateral, setup guides, reference architectures, and handoff materials.
Validate technical feasibility, data dependencies, integration complexity, user experience assumptions, and implementation risks early in the sales cycle.
Help accelerate opportunity conversion by making AI solutions concrete, credible, and client-specific.
Contribute lessons learned, reusable code, prompts, agent patterns, and implementation guidance back into the global FDE knowledge base.



Success Measures


Pursuit deal volume, measured as total TCV value of AI deals where the FDE supported.
Pursuit win rate for AI deals where the FDE supported.
Prototype-to-pipeline conversion, measured by demos, prototypes, or POCs that convert into qualified pipeline, funded POCs, or downstream implementation work.
Utilization, reuse of technical assets, demo quality, and stakeholder feedback.



Basic Qualifications


5+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, ML engineering, solution engineering, technical consulting, or related hands-on technical roles.
2+ years of experience building or deploying AI, ML, GenAI, LLM, RAG, agentic AI, data science, or automation solutions.
Hands-on experience with programming languages and frameworks such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, FastAPI, Flask, React, LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar technologies.
Experience integrating APIs, data sources, model providers, workflow tools, and cloud services into working demos or prototypes.
Working knowledge of responsible AI, security, data handling, privacy, and enterprise deployment considerations.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
Fluency in German and English



Preferred Skills


Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google/Gemini, Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, vector databases, model registries, and MLOps/LLMOps tooling.
Experience working directly with clients, sales teams, or product teams to rapidly prototype solutions under ambiguous conditions.
AI/ML, cloud, data engineering, or software engineering certifications.
Strong technical curiosity, client empathy, communication, bias for action, collaboration, and ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
Ability to travel as required for client and internal engagements.



Benefits


Flexible working hours with a flexitime arrangement; business travel time is considered working time
30 days of annual leave, plus December 24 and December 31 as additional non-working days
The option to take a sabbatical of up to one year
Remote work and mobile working from other EU countries
Attractive benefits and compensation optimisation programmes, including an occupational pension scheme, JobRad bike leasing, a public transport pass, exclusive discounts through Corporate Benefits, and much more
Comprehensive health and preventive care benefits, including extended continued remuneration in the event of illness, occupational health services, worldwide accident insurance covering both work-related and leisure-time accidents, and family support services
A wide range of internal and external development opportunities through the NTT DATA Academy, including specialist training, certification programmes, soft-skills training, and access to Udemy
Varied corporate volunteering opportunities, as well as diverse communities and initiatives focusing on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion, sustainability, and more, with knowledge sharing on an equal footing
A team-oriented corporate culture with plenty of scope to contribute ideas and shape your work



With us, you will have countless opportunities to think big, act boldly, and take responsibility. Shape your future in a culture that fosters a sense of belonging and gives you the space to learn and build your network.

Diversity is an essential part of our success and our corporate culture. Free from prejudice regarding gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnic or social background, religion, or disability, we look forward to getting to know you. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preference if equally qualified.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.

Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and have grown to over 240 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.

Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!

About Our Tech Stack



Dagster
Snowflake
DBT
Amazon Quick
AWS (Lambda, S3, ECR)



About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic and cross-functional team. As a Senior Data Scientist at Northmill, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, fellow Data Scientists, Analysts, and key business stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities and leverage data-driven insights that will drive our business forward. Your primary focus will be on leading data science initiatives across various areas of the bank.

In this holistic role, you will be a part of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection and preparation to implementation. You will work closely with Data Engineers to ensure the availability of high-quality data, as well as with Analysts and business leaders to ensure that your models are effectively applied and communicated across the business. Your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of our fintech bank, and your work will have a direct impact on our success.

Responsibilities



Take proactive ownership of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection, through modeling and analysis, to model deployment and implementation.
Work closely with Data Engineers to acquire and transform data.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and advise stakeholders to proactively anticipate business needs and translate them into data science solutions.
Create and present actionable insights and data visualizations that drive decision-making processes across the bank.
Continuously monitor and optimize models to proactively drive model refinement and communicate performance findings to stakeholders.
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in data science, proactively proposing new initiatives where applicable.



Qualifications

The ideal fit should have experience in statistical modeling and machine learning, from the financial sector, combined with strong problem-solving skills, analytical abilities, excellent stakeholder communication, and a prestigeless, collaborative spirit. We value individuals who are passionate about utilizing data to solve practical challenges and drive business outcomes.



Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics)
+5 years of experience in data science or related roles.
Proficiency in SQL/Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.
Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis and machine learning, including hands-on experience using common ML libraries.
Proficiency with Git and version control in collaborative settings.



What We Offer



A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views
An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact
Great opportunities for professional development
Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance
Conference abroad every other year
Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday
Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office

Northmill Bank is a tech company with a banking license aiming to improve financial life, offer merchants smart solutions and erase the borders between in-store and online.

Northmill creates a more personal and relevant experience for people and companies, helping more than 2,500 merchants and 250,000 end users.

Title: (Senior) Data Scientist
Description:
Insurance is all about life. And it’s all about data. At If we are developing solutions that have the power to turn misfortunes into possibilities and dreams into reality. We are now looking for a Data Scientist or Senior Data Scientist to join a Nordic team focused on developing and productionising machine learning and advanced analytics solutions.




About The Role

You will be working in an agile team, which uses AI/ML to support use cases in customer acquisition and sales, customer services operations as well as claims handling and operations. We use a wide set of approaches in our solutions by combining data and software with the use of natural language processing (NLP), image analysis and generative AI, as well as more traditional predictive modelling and classification.




Key Responsibilities Include

Driving and developing all aspects of data science solutions for our use cases, from understanding the business problem, transforming and refining the needed data, developing models and pipelines, deploying solutions to production and following up on the quality, performance and retraining of models.
Steering on stakeholder engagement and ensuring that we are supporting their needs effectively.
Maintaining a good understanding of If’s data and analytical landscape and guiding the organisation on technical decisions related to AI/ML.
Collaborating with the team to define the approaches to solutions and iterating on them together. This may include evaluating new methods and technologies in the field.
Proactively identifying new opportunities to apply or extend solutions related to business needs.
Coaching more junior data scientists and pushing for best data science practices.




Who are you?

As a Data Scientist or Senior Data Scientist, we think you have a genuine interest in data science and machine learning and you stay curious to their state-of-the-art developments. We expect you may have proven experience and strong understanding in one or several areas ranging from data science, machine learning, data engineering to software engineering. You should be able to drive complex data science solutions to production-level. You are comfortable to steer on the selection of appropriate techniques, tools and approaches for new problems and keen to contribute to If’s analytical and data maturity.




We think you are interested in coaching more junior data scientists. You must be able to work and co-operate closely with other data scientists and data/ML engineers as well as advice on complex topics to stakeholders. You should be comfortable to work in a Nordic setting with colleagues of diverse professional and cultural backgrounds.




You Also Have

Demonstrated experience and strong understanding in data science and machine learning in a commercial setting.
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Experience with version control and software development practices to write reusable modules, models and pipelines to be deployed in test and production environment.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with stakeholders from all levels of the organisation.
Interest in data exploration and data development.
A degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or a related field.
Fluency in English.
Experience with Azure and Databricks is a bonus




About The Team

As part of the Advanced Analytics Chapter you will work together with other data scientists spread across offices in the Nordics in agile teams. We strive to maintain a work environment where you as a data scientist can both develop and be challenged professionally. We are team players with a strong drive forward and the ambition to always deliver the best possible result. You can also read more about how we work with data science and ML in If’s tech blog. https://medium.com/if-tech




We offer

Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits




Recruitment process

Apply with CV and answer a questionnaire.
30-minute initial interview with hiring manager.
Technical step: Take-home exercise followed by technical interview with hiring manager and members of the team.
HR step: Logical and personality tests followed by HR interview to discuss the test results.
Background and reference checks.




Application deadline: We will review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis. The application will be closed when a suitable candidate has been found.

To apply for the position: Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the application form.

Work location: Stockholm, Gothenburg, Copenhagen, Oslo, Espoo or Turku. We have a hybrid working arrangement, where you work at least three days per week in the office.

Travelling: Some travelling in the Nordic countries is required.

Start: As soon as possible.




It is a requirement for the position that If’s extended fit & proper requirements, including background checks, can be met.




If you have questions about the process or the position, please contact Lu An, Chapter Lead Advanced Analytics at lu.an@if.se.




We look forward to your application!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Job Description

At Billerud we believe that when we have tomorrow in mind, we will do our very best today. It is thanks to our employees that we are a world-leading company within the field of renewable paper and packaging materials. Do you want to realize your true value and work for a sustainable tomorrow? Join us!

We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our Global Advanced Analytics team. The team plays a key role in accelerating the use of advanced analytics and AI across Billerud. Together with business stakeholders, technical experts, and IT teams, you will solve complex business challenges and transform data into measurable business value.

As a Data Scientist in the Global Advanced Analytics team, you will work with a broad range of business areas within Billerud and across the full analytics lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and exploring data to developing, deploying, and integrating advanced analytical solutions into business processes.

The position can be located in Grums, Frövi, Skärblacka, Gävle, Karlsborg or Solna.

Your Main Tasks Will Be


Solve business problems using advanced analytics, machine learning, optimization, and AI.
Develop and deploy predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and AI-driven solutions.
Translate analytical insights into actionable business recommendations.
Collaborate with stakeholders to identify use cases, define objectives, business value, and success criteria’s.
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and integrated into business operations.
Contribute to data platform, analytics and AI architectures, standards, and best practices.
Share knowledge and support capability building across the organization.


At Billerud, we put Safety First. Together we take great pride in our responsibility to contribute to a safe work environment. Please read more about our Safety First initiative here.

Qualifications

To succeed in this position, we believe you have:


University degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
Minimum five years of experience within data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, optimization, or a related field.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL or equivalent.
Experience working throughout the full analytics lifecycle, from problem definition and data exploration to modelling, validation, and implementation.
Ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English


Meritorious


PhD or postgraduate education
Experience with cloud-based analytics environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with generative AI, AI agents, or other modern AI technologies.
Knowledge of data platform architecture, MLOps processes, or software development practices.
Experience from manufacturing, process industry, or other industrial environments.


Personal qualities

For us, personality is important. To succeed in this position, we believe you are a curious and analytical problem solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges and turning data into practical business outcomes. You take initiative and move ideas forward, even when all parameters are not fully defined.

You collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders, building trust and creating strong partnerships across functions and regions. Since you will communicate advanced analytical concepts to different audiences, you are able to explain complex topics in a clear and transparent way.

You structure your work well, balancing multiple initiatives while maintaining focus on agreed objectives, delivering results, and creating tangible business value.

Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in We care for each other and We do what we say.

Contact

For more information about the position contact hiring manager Gustaf Jonsson (Senior Manager Global Advanced Analytics) at gustaf.jonsson@billerud.com

For more information about the recruitment process contact Erika Collin (Senior Group Talent Acquisition Partner) at erika.collin@billerud.com

Application information

Welcome with your application no later than 2026-10-02. 

Selection may take place continuously during this process.

Billerud is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Why us? 


A unique opportunity to apply advanced analytics and AI to real business challenges in a global industrial company.
Work with modern technologies and contribute to Billerud's AI and analytics journey.
Be part of a highly skilled Global Advanced Analytics team with significant influence on strategic business initiatives.
Opportunity to contribute to a more sustainable future.
Development and career opportunities in an international organization.
Performance-based bonus, occupational pension, and a wide range of employee benefits according to company policy.


Do you want to help create a sustainable future through your work?

At Billerud, we are fully committed to reduce our and our customers carbon footprint by offering high-performance paper and packaging materials. We are convinced that the right solutions can be important tools to help fight climate change. That's why we see it as our responsibility to enable the best packaging choices, for a better tomorrow.

Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.

We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.

Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our Global Advanced Analytics team. The team plays a key role in accelerating the use of advanced analytics and AI across Billerud. Together with business stakeholders, technical experts, and IT teams, you will solve complex business challenges and transform data into measurable business value.

As a Data Scientist in the Global Advanced Analytics team, you will work with a broad range of business areas within Billerud and across the full analytics lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and exploring data to developing, deploying, and integrating advanced analytical solutions into business processes.

The position can be located in Grums, Frövi, Skärblacka, Gävle, Karlsborg or Solna.

Your Main Tasks Will Be

  • Solve business problems using advanced analytics, machine learning, optimization, and AI.
  • Develop and deploy predictive models, machine learning algorithms, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Translate analytical insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify use cases, define objectives, business value, and success criteria’s.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and integrated into business operations.
  • Contribute to data platform, analytics and AI architectures, standards, and best practices.
  • Share knowledge and support capability building across the organization.

At Billerud, we put Safety First. Together we take great pride in our responsibility to contribute to a safe work environment. Please read more about our Safety First initiative here.

Qualifications

To succeed in this position, we believe you have:

  • University degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum five years of experience within data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, optimization, or a related field.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL or equivalent.
  • Experience working throughout the full analytics lifecycle, from problem definition and data exploration to modelling, validation, and implementation.
  • Ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional proficiency in Swedish and English

Meritorious

  • PhD or postgraduate education
  • Experience with cloud-based analytics environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric
  • Experience with generative AI, AI agents, or other modern AI technologies.
  • Knowledge of data platform architecture, MLOps processes, or software development practices.
  • Experience from manufacturing, process industry, or other industrial environments.

Personal qualities

For us, personality is important. To succeed in this position, we believe you are a curious and analytical problem solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges and turning data into practical business outcomes. You take initiative and move ideas forward, even when all parameters are not fully defined.

You collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders, building trust and creating strong partnerships across functions and regions. Since you will communicate advanced analytical concepts to different audiences, you are able to explain complex topics in a clear and transparent way.

You structure your work well, balancing multiple initiatives while maintaining focus on agreed objectives, delivering results, and creating tangible business value.

Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in We care for each other and We do what we say.

For more information about the position contact hiring manager Gustaf Jonsson (Senior Manager Global Advanced Analytics) at gustaf.jonsson@billerud.com

For more information about the recruitment process contact Erika Collin (Senior Group Talent Acquisition Partner) at erika.collin@billerud.com

Welcome with your application no later than 2026-10-02. 

Selection may take place continuously during this process.

Billerud is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Why us? 

  • A unique opportunity to apply advanced analytics and AI to real business challenges in a global industrial company.

  • Be part of a highly skilled Global Advanced Analytics team with significant influence on strategic business initiatives.

Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.

We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.

Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.

Rollen som Data Scientist på B3

Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:


Gräva i data och hitta insikter som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!

Det är din passion för AI och data som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:


Har du en universitetsutbildning inom matematik eller statistik? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


Men framför allt...

Har du erfarenhet av Machine Learning och Python? Grymt – det är värdefullt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framförallt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har koll på A/B-testning, modellering eller visualisering, är det ett plus – men absolut inget krav.

Varför välja B3 Indes?

💡 Utveckling & karriär – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.

🌿 Balans & välmående – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.

🚀 Energi & gemenskap – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.

❤️ Vi bryr oss – på riktigt – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.

En arbetsplats som gör skillnad:

Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.

Hos oss får du friheten att styra över dina uppdrag, din arbetstid och din utveckling. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga löner, flexibilitet att forma din vardag och en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid. Och vi vet att gemenskap är minst lika viktigt som teknik – därför satsar vi på allt från konferensresor och sommarfester till sköna AW:s där vi kan släppa jobbet för en stund.

Om B3 Consulting Group

B3 Consulting Group är ett expansivt konsultbolag med cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi brinner för innovation och hjälper Sveriges ledande företag och organisationer att skapa framtidens möjligheter genom digital transformation. B3 finns på tolv orter i Sverige samt i Polen, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. Bolaget grundades 2003, är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm Small Cap och omsatte 1 141 MSEK 2023.

Vi är stolta över vår prisbelönta företagskultur, där olikheter, erfarenheter och gemensam energi värdesätts. Som ett etiskt och transparent bolag strävar vi efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi är även engagerade i Women in Tech och initiativ för att stärka AI-utbildning för kvinnor. 2024 utsågs vi till Årets Employer Branding-företag, och vår HR-chef vann titeln Årets HR-chef.

Är du redo att bli en del av ett företag där din passion för AI och data kan göra skillnad? Läs mer om oss och våra möjligheter här!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Be part of something altogether life-changing!

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. With associates across 40+ countries, Cytiva is a place where every day is a learning opportunity – so you can grow your career and expand your skills in the long term.

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join our Resins & Technology Data Science R&D team in Uppsala, Sweden. In this role, you will support the full product development lifecycle, from early discovery and feasibility assessment through design, proof-of-concept, transfer into production and routine manufacturing support. You will combine data, technology, and scientific expertise to solve complex challenges, develop data science solutions, and apply advanced analytics and AI/ML methods. Working closely with researchers, domain experts, data scientists, and cross-functional partners across the business, you will contribute to products used in the manufacturing of life-saving biological drugs while strengthening our data-driven culture.

What You'll Do


Perform data analysis, troubleshoot development projects, and develop, implement, and tune predictive models.
Support experimental design (DoE) and planning.
Drive and foster a data-driven culture within R&D.
Work with R&D SMEs to understand scientific workflows and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and AI/ML.
Design and document maintainable solutions and data flows in collaboration with stakeholders and IT architects.
Document and present results clearly, both orally and in writing.
Identify and implement relevant new techniques while following technical developments in the field.
Work effectively in a dynamic environment with adaptability, independence and strong collaboration.


Who You Are


PhD in a technical discipline, with expert competency in data science/chemometrics/bioinformatics, or equivalent industry experience.
Proficient in R and/or Python
Proficient in explorative data analysis, cleaning, and transformation
Well versed in multivariate statistics and predictive modelling
Experience with modern AI/ML techniques
Experience with solutions for data management, cleaning, and transformation
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and Azure) and their data services
Experience with version control/Git
Fluent in English, both verbally and in writing


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


Experience with image analysis and/or computer vision
Experience with Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, and agentic workflow design
Experience in Design of Experiments (DoE)
Experience in the SQL language and databases
Experience with Web development
Experience with DevOps and CI/CD
Practical wet lab experience and experience with analytical chemistry


Does this sound interesting? Submit your application today.

Applications will be read and reviewed throughout the application period; this means the position might be filled prior to the last date of advertising.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Omvandla organisationers AI-ambitioner till mätbart affärsvärde




AI har gått från framtidsvision till en affärskritisk prioritet. Organisationer inom alla branscher utforskar hur AI kan förbättra beslutsfattande, effektivisera verksamheter och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter.




Många har redan tagit de första stegen genom pilotprojekt och experiment. Utmaningen handlar nu om att skala initiativen, operationalisera modeller och bygga lösningar som levererar verkligt värde över tid.




Våra kunder söker praktiska och hållbara sätt att använda AI för att lösa konkreta affärsutmaningar. De behöver lösningar som är tekniskt robusta, relevanta för verksamheten och som skapar förtroende hos de människor som ska använda dem.




Som Data Scientist på Nexer Insight hjälper du kunder att identifiera möjligheter, utveckla intelligenta lösningar och ta AI från idé till produktion. Ditt arbete påverkar hur organisationer använder AI, fattar beslut och skapar värde i en av vår tids mest betydelsefulla teknikförändringar.




Utmaningar du kommer att arbeta med:

Förbättra beslutsfattande genom avancerad analys
Tillämpa Machine Learning på komplexa affärsutmaningar
Skala AI-initiativ inom organisationen
Bygga förtroende för AI genom styrning och ansvarsfull användning
Skapa mätbart värde från investeringar i data och AI




Projekt/arbetsuppgifter du kan bli en del av:

Utveckla AI-lösningar som stödjer affärskritiska beslut
Bygga prediktiva modeller för prognoser, optimering och riskhantering
Skapa Generative AI-lösningar baserade på LLM:er och Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Utveckla AI-assistenter som förbättrar produktivitet och kundupplevelser
Hjälpa kunder att identifiera och prioritera AI-möjligheter




Du använder din tekniska expertis och affärsförståelse för att driva idéer hela vägen till mätbara resultat hos kunder.




Tekniker och plattformar du kan komma att arbeta med:

Azure AI Services
Azure Machine Learning
Microsoft Fabric
Databricks
Python
PySpark
LLM:er
Generative AI
MLOps




Varför Nexer Insight?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett team med arkitekter, data engineers, data scientists och AI-specialister som tillsammans hjälper kunder att lösa komplexa verksamhets- och teknikrelaterade utmaningar.




Du får möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor, påverka tekniska beslut och arbeta nära kunder i projekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.




Du blir en del av ett team vars kompetens har uppmärksammats av Microsoft genom vårt Solutions Partner-status och våra Advanced Specializations inom Analytics på Microsoft Azure samt Data & AI. Det är certifieringar som endast ett fåtal organisationer i Norden har, vilket speglar den erfarenhet, specialistkompetens och leveransförmåga som finns hos våra medarbetare.




Vi är även Databricks Consulting Partner med Select-status, vilket ger oss möjlighet att arbeta nära en av marknadens ledande plattformar för data, analys och AI. För dig innebär det möjligheten att arbeta med moderna teknologier, erfarna specialister och några av marknadens mest spännande data- och AI-initiativ.




Med rötter i svensk entreprenörsanda och innovation har vi hjälpt kunder att ligga steget före sedan internets början – i allt från strategi till teknik och kommunikation.




Idag är vi en betrodd partner för några av världens största och mest krävande organisationer.

Vi hjälper organisationer att omsätta data och AI till mätbart affärsvärde genom att kombinera strategi, styrning, teknik och förändringsledning. På så sätt skapar vi förutsättningar för ansvarsfull AI-adoption, datadrivet beslutsfattande och långsiktig tillväxt.




För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av:

Minimum 6–10 års erfarenhet inom Data Science, Machine Learning eller AI
Att driva projekt från idé till produktion
Python och PySpark
Machine Learning och statistisk modellering
Databricks
LLM:er
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
NLP
Computer Vision
MLOps
Containerteknik
Svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift




Vill du vara med och hjälpa några av Sveriges ledande organisationer att omsätta AI till verkligt affärsvärde?




Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Är du vår nästa Data Scientist?




Vi utvecklar just nu hur vi arbetar med data och analys på ATG. Med nya verktyg och en modern dataplattform kommer vi kunna både fördjupa den analys vi redan gör och testa nya angreppssätt – från explorativ analys och prediktiva modeller till AI-baserade analysverktyg.




Som Data Scientist hos oss arbetar du nära verksamheten med kund- och affärsfrågor. Det kan handla om att förstå kundbeteenden, mäta effekten av förändringar, utveckla modeller som skapar konkret nytta eller hitta helt nya sätt att använda vår data.




I rollen kommer du bland annat:




Driva analyser hela vägen – från att förstå och konkretisera ett affärsproblem, välja lämplig metod och bearbeta data till att presentera insikter som verksamheten kan förstå och agera på
Analysera kundbeteenden och mäta effekten av olika förändringar och initiativ, exempelvis genom experiment och kontrollgruppsanalys
Utveckla modeller och se till att de faktiskt går att använda och följa upp
Arbeta mycket i SQL och Python/R
Samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten – från affären och andra analytiker till andra kompetenser inom data
Vara med och utforska hur vi kan använda AI på ett vettigt sätt – både i verksamheten och i vårt eget analysarbete




Är det här du?

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har ett starkt affärsintresse och är bekväm med statistik, machine learning och kvantitativ problemlösning. Du kan självständigt arbeta från rådata till slutsats eller produktionssatt lösning. SQL och Python/R är naturliga delar av ditt dagliga arbete, och erfarenhet av moderna molnbaserade dataplattformar, exempelvis Snowflake, är meriterande.

Du har sannolikt en akademisk bakgrund inom ett kvantitativt område, till exempel teknik, statistik, matematik, datavetenskap eller nationalekonomi.




Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, strukturerad och trivs med att jobba självständigt. Du behöver inte ha jobbat med spel tidigare, men vi tror att du har ett genuint intresse för spel och är nyfiken på att förstå våra kunder och hur våra produkter fungerar.




”Som ledare vill jag skapa en välkomnande och tillåtande miljö, där vi har stort förtroende för varandras kompetens, tar eget ansvar och har nära till skratt.”

Jag har jobbat på ATG i snart elva år och det som fortfarande gör jobbet roligt är kombinationen av en spännande affär, mycket data och frågor där analys faktiskt kan göra skillnad. I teamet vill jag att vi ska vara nyfikna, testa nya angreppssätt och ha egna idéer om hur vi kan använda vår data bättre för att driva affären framåt. För mig är det viktigt med stort eget ansvar och frihet i hur man löser sina uppgifter

- Filip Dyrssen, Head of Customer Analytics




We are the game

I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.




Join the game!

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.




Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

Title: Senior Data Scientist | Candy Crush Saga
Description:
Craft:

Data, Analytics & Strategy

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to work closely with product, game design, and engineering on game difficulty, progression, and economy in Candy Crush Saga. You will help ensure that our 23,000+ levels and game features combine into a balanced, engaging, and evolving player experience.

This is a role close to the game itself: your analyses, experiments, and models will directly shape gameplay decisions that reach millions of players. You will have significant ownership of your problem space and be a trusted analytical voice in product and design discussions.

Your role within the Kingdom


Analyze game difficulty, progression, and player behavior across the level catalog to identify friction, pacing issues, and opportunities
Design, monitor, and analyze A/B tests related to difficulty, features, and economy
Use data, models, and simulations to inform difficulty tuning, balance, and how features, boosters, and economy mechanics interact with player outcomes
Bring a strong analytical perspective to product and design discussions, helping shape priorities and trade-offs
Communicate insights, experiment results, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy
Define tracking specifications so the data needed to understand player interaction with levels and features is available and reliable, and build your own data models and dashboards where needed


Skills to create thrills

Product & Player Understanding


Strong product sense with the ability to reason about player experience, engagement, and frustration
Ability to translate design intent and game experience into measurable hypotheses and analyses


Analytics & Experimentation


Strong analytical coding skills in Python or R
Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large-scale player data
Solid understanding of A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical inference
Experience combining experimental results with observational analysis
Comfortable defining tracking requirements and building data models and dashboards to support your own analyses


Modeling & Problem Solving


Ability to systematically break down complex game systems into solvable analytical problems
Experience with simulation, optimization, or algorithmic approaches is a strong plus


Communication & Collaboration


Ability to influence decisions through clear storytelling, visualization, and data-driven reasoning
Comfortable working iteratively and cross-functionally with product managers, game designers, and engineers


Tasty bonus points


Experience with game difficulty balancing, progression systems, or virtual economies
Background in behavioral psychology, economics, or game theory
Experience in the games industry or other large-scale consumer products
Familiarity with large-scale experimentation platforms and live-operated products


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Anti-cheat
Description:
The Anti-cheat team at Embark is responsible for upholding the integrity of our games, identifying instances of unfair play, and protecting the experience of our players. We have a versatile toolbox at our disposal, which we continuously evolve and refine, including client-side protections, third-party systems, machine-learning models. Being a core function supporting all of Embark games, we collaborate with many different stakeholders throughout the organisation, such as game teams, legal and community management.

We are now looking for a well rounded Data scientist to strengthen our operational capacity. As a member of our Anti-cheat team you will, among other things, be responsible for supporting our game teams with investigations into suspicious activities, performance analyses of detection rules, exploration of data and player behavior to design new rules. Your statistical background helps you identify significant patterns, and separate signals from noise. We operate in a complex environment where billions of telemetry events and other data are collected each day from all our games.

You are likely curious to continuously learn new skills. You enjoy working autonomously and taking initiatives, while also collaborating within and across teams. You have a passion for data and technology, and feel excited to use your skills to help protect our players from unfair play and malicious actors. By being creative and experimental you aim to solve problems in a game-changing way.

Example Of Responsibilities


Perform ad-hoc investigations into suspicious patterns and gameplay behavior
Work with game teams and customer support to verify and explain rule detections
Support our Esport event teams with vetting of contestants
Provide reports and performance analyses of our anti-cheat operation



We would love if you have


A creative and curious mind.
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with database querying, preferably using tools such as BigQuery
Proficiency in Python.
Experience working with Google Cloud Platform.
Experience working with ETLs and data pipelines.
Experience in predictive modeling and analysis over large datasets
Professional English communication skills.
Experience and/or interest in games and anti-cheat will be considered a bonus!



At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.

Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

Title: Data Scientist, Company Planning & Execution
Description:
How does a company with thousands of people building hundreds of products stay focused on what matters most? That's the question the Company Planning and Execution (CPE) team works on every day. We design the systems, processes, and insights that help Spotify plan, prioritise, and deliver at scale.

As a Data Scientist on CPE, you'll sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations. You'll bring clarity to complex questions by turning operational and strategic information into clear stories, recommendations, and decision frameworks that help leaders and teams act faster and smarter. You'll also explore how AI and automation can change the way people access insights and make decisions.

You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, PMs, and business partners across the company to help refine how Spotify executes at scale. If you like making sense of ambiguity, care about how organisations work, and want your analysis to shape real decisions, this is the role.

What You'll Do


Formulate hypotheses related to how Spotify plans and delivers, and communicate insights effectively to a range of audiences.
Apply analytical techniques — including statistical models and machine learning — to identify trends and generate insights that improve how we work.
Build and maintain the data models, pipelines, and dashboards that provide visibility into how Spotify plans and executes.
Develop structured narratives and recommendations — not just charts, but the "why" and "so what" — in our semi-annual Planning and Execution Insight reports and recurring briefings.
Explore how AI and automation can make insights faster to produce and easier to access across the company.


Who You Are


Curious about how organisations work — not just the data, but the decisions and systems behind it.
5+ years of experience with a quantitative background in science, economics, engineering, or a related field.
Strong interpersonal skills and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across levels and functions.
Able to take messy, complex datasets and turn them into clear recommendations and stories that land with non-technical audiences.
Proficient in SQL and Python, comfortable in BigQuery, and experienced with tools like dbt, Tableau, or Looker.
Experience with operational or work management data is a plus.


Where You'll Be


This role is based in London or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best, with 2–3 days per week in the office.


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

Title: AI & Data Scientist
Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your role

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with clients to understand complex business challenges and turn data into measurable business value. You will design, develop, and validate AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions.

At Capgemini, we believe great Data Scientists combine analytical rigour with business understanding and technological curiosity. You may work with forecasting customer demand, optimising industrial operations, building recommendation engines, or assessing whether an AI use case is feasible.

You will help clients make evidence-based decisions by applying statistical modelling, machine learning, data visualisation, Generative AI, and advanced analytics.

In this role you will play a key role in:


Data Wrangling & Analytics: work with data wrangling, advanced analytics, statistical modelling, machine learning, and data visualisation to uncover insights and support better decisions. Use tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI, and Qlik.
Use Case Assessment & Experimentation: run AI use case assessments and feasibility analyses. Frame business problems as analytical questions and design experiments to test assumptions and evaluate potential value.
Predictive Analytics & Optimisation: build forecasting, recommendation, optimisation, predictive maintenance, and decision-support solutions.
Model Validation: validate models for performance, robustness, drift, and explainability. Apply experimental design, A/B testing, and uncertainty quantification when evaluating models and analytical results.
Generative AI & Agentic AI: apply Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI agents, and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex where they create tangible business value and complement traditional Data Science approaches.
Data Platforms & Cloud: work with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Spark, and cloud-native analytics environments across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.
Client Collaboration: partner closely with stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical solutions. Explain models and analytical results clearly to business stakeholders and ensure that solutions align with the EU AI Act and GDPR.
Deployment & Knowledge Transfer: package models for deployment using APIs and REST services, document the solutions, and transfer knowledge to the client team.


Your profile


Experience as a Data Scientist, Analytics Consultant, or similar, with an interest in Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, intelligent automation, and AI copilots.
Experience with LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, or similar) and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex.
Experience with Python (including Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, PySpark) or R.
Strong SQL, database experience, and knowledge of statistical methods including experimental design, A/B testing, and uncertainty quantification.
Experience with analytics and visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI, and Qlik.
Knowledge of cloud analytics platforms, APIs, REST services, and Git version control.
Ability to explain analytical models and results to business stakeholders and identify opportunities to create business value through analytics.
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related quantitative field, and fluent English.


If you also have experience with Databricks, MLOps, knowledge graphs (Neo4j), Kubernetes, Docker, and speaks Swedish fluent that's even better!

What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here


The opportunity to shape your own development, whether you want to deepen your expertise in Data & AI or explore new roles and areas of responsibility.
A culture where learning is part of everyday work – through certifications, communities, knowledge hubs, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge.
Flexibility in how and where you work, with opportunities for hybrid working when assignments allow.


Application

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway.

We believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams. We actively strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. We welcome applicants of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. Title: Data Scientists & ML Engineers
Description:
Vårt team skapar datadrivna effektiva verksamheter - Visst vill du vara med?

Vill du arbeta med AI, Machine Learning och datadriven utveckling i projekt som gör skillnad på riktigt? På Agio får du kombinera teknik, analys och innovation i uppdrag som spänner över viktiga samhällsfunktioner.

Vi söker nu erfarna Data Scientists och ML Engineers till våra team i Stockholm och Luleå. Du väljer själv vilken ort du vill utgå ifrån.

Om rollerna

Som Data Scientist eller ML Engineer på Agio hjälper du våra kunder att ta nästa steg i sin digitala resa.

Våra kunder behöver stöd inom dessa två huvudinriktningar, och du behöver inte vara stark inom båda. En riktigt bra Data Scientist kan vara relevant för oss även utan erfarenhet som ML Engineer, och vice versa.

Data Scientist

Du använder data för att skapa konkret affärs- och verksamhetsvärde genom avancerad analys, statistik, Machine Learning och AI – för att exempelvis förutse, klassificera, optimera och skapa bättre beslutsstöd. Vi söker teknikorienterade Data Scientists som har en stark programmeringsvana. Du arbetar med:
Machine Learning-modeller för prediktion, klassificering och optimering
Prediktioner och prognoser
Att testa hypoteser och genomföra A/B-tester
Att träna, testa och utvärdera modeller
Att förklara analyser och resultat på ett begripligt sätt för verksamheten


ML Engineer

Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan Data Science och Data Engineering, med fokus på att få modeller och AI-lösningar att fungera i produktion – från experiment och PoC till skalbara produktionslösningar. Du arbetar med:
Att ta modeller framtagna av Data Scientists och göra dem produktionsklara
Att bygga lösningar för att träna, deploya och köra modeller automatiskt
Att säkerställa att modeller fungerar i produktion, med hänsyn till exempelvis latens och skalbarhet
Att övervaka modeller och följa drift, datadrift och prestanda över tid


Du blir en viktig del i att hjälpa organisationer att utnyttja digitaliseringens möjligheter, från effektivisering till helt nya arbetssätt.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av
Minst 4 års arbete som Data Scientist, ML Engineer, dataanalytiker eller inom AI/ML-roller
Avancerad dataanalys och AI/ML-modeller – till exempel prediktion, klassificering, klustring eller produktionssättning av modeller, beroende på om din profil ligger mer åt Data Scientist eller ML Engineer
Python eller R
Versionshantering (Git)
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Beroende på vilken profil du känner dig mest hemma i väger vi även in:
Data Scientist: erfarenhet av bibliotek som scikit-learn, pandas/polars eller statsmodels, samt datavisualisering med Matplotlib, Seaborn eller BI-verktyg som Power BI
ML Engineer: erfarenhet av TensorFlow/PyTorch, containerteknik (Docker, Kubernetes) och verktyg för MLOps som MLflow


Det viktigaste för oss är inte en checklista av verktyg, utan att du faktiskt har arbetat med avancerad analys och modeller, eller med att sätta modeller och AI-lösningar i produktion.

Meriterande om du även har
Kunskap om informationssäkerhet, GDPR och etisk AI
Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller andra molntjänster, exempelvis Azure ML, SageMaker eller Databricks
API-integrationer och arbete med data från flera olika källor
Vana av RAG-lösningar, agenter och ramverk som LangChain, LangGraph eller LlamaIndex


Teamet du blir en del av

Du blir en del av vårt team inom Dataanalys & BI med konsulter i både Luleå och Stockholm. Här möter du kollegor som brinner för sitt område, som hjälper varandra att utvecklas och som tillsammans bygger lösningar från ax till limpa.

Området är prioriterat hos oss, och du kommer att spela en viktig roll i teamets fortsatta utveckling. Samtidigt får du en personlig och skräddarsydd utvecklingsresa där du tillsammans med teamet stärker Agios affär och skapar värde för våra kunder.

Varför Agio?

Agio erbjuder dig:
Trygghet genom kollektivavtal och stabila kundrelationer
En arbetsplats som värnar om balans i livet
En personlig kompetensresa där du får utvecklas i din riktning
En platt organisation där du får stort inflytande
Ett företag som satsar långsiktigt både på dig och våra kunder


Vill du växa med oss? Skicka in en ansökan genom att svara på några korta frågor nedan.

Title: Senior & Expert Data Scientists - Build the Future of AI in Operations
Description:
Job ID: 6430

Join us in scaling Generative AI across one of the largest Nordic organizations

We are looking for experienced Senior and Expert Data Scientists to help shape the next generation of AI-powered solutions across Operations. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of Generative AI, transforming ambitious ideas into secure, scalable, and production-grade applications that deliver tangible business value.

About Our Team

Our mission is to enable Operations to deliver on its 2030 strategic ambitions by creating clarity on priorities, driving data-driven decision-making, and ensuring optimal allocation of resources and investments. The team plays a key role in accelerating transformation across all Operations Service Lines through the practical application of Artificial Intelligence and Automation.

You will join a growing team of specialists, engineers, and business experts who are passionate about solving complex problems and creating innovative solutions that improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and decision-making.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

As a Senior or Expert Data Scientist, you will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI solutions from concept to production.

You will:


Identify and shape high-impact AI and Generative AI opportunities with business stakeholders
Prototype, build, deploy, and monitor production-grade AI applications
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI, and LLM-powered solutions
Collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, architects, and business experts to deliver end-to-end solutions
Drive experimentation, evaluation frameworks, and model quality assessments
Contribute to AI architecture, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices
Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, governance, and Responsible AI requirements
Support the adoption of AI across Operations through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical leadership


Who You Are

We believe you are curious, pragmatic, and passionate about turning cutting-edge technology into real business outcomes.

Required experience and skills:


MSc or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience is also highly valued.
3+ years of experience delivering production-grade AI, Machine Learning, or advanced analytics solutions
Strong Python development skills and experience with modern AI/ML frameworks
Hands-on experience developing Generative AI applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic frameworks, MCP, A2A, or similar emerging technologies
Proven ability to take ideas from prototype to scalable production solutions
Experience with testing, evaluation, experimentation, and performance measurement of AI systems
Strong understanding of software engineering, DevOps, observability, CI/CD, and production support
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


Highly valued experience:


Experience working within AWS-based AI and data environments, hands-on experience with SageMaker, Bedrock, and cloud-native AI development
Experience integrating AI solutions through Kong API Gateway and enterprise API ecosystems
Knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, model governance, and responsible AI practices
Experience working in regulated industries such as banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, or telecommunications


What We Offer

People join us when they want to make a real impact. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on strategic AI initiatives, solve meaningful business challenges, and help shape how AI is adopted at scale.

We offer:


The opportunity to work on some of the most exciting AI and Generative AI initiatives in the Nordics
A collaborative and highly skilled team with deep expertise across AI, engineering, operations, and transformation
Significant opportunities for professional growth, learning, and career development
A culture built on collaboration, ownership, passion, and courage
Flexible hybrid working arrangements
A strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities


Ready to shape the future of AI?

If you are passionate about building impactful AI solutions and want to help drive one of the largest AI transformations in the Nordic region, we'd love to hear from you.

We review applications continuously and will be hiring on an ongoing basis. Apply today and become part of our AI journey.

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Our way of working - We believe in bringing people together and want our offices to remain a cornerstone of the company. Our offices are where we connect, collaborate, learn from one another and build our culture. Therefore, as a principle, we work mostly from the office.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 11/10/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Harit Fanish at harit.fanish@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Only for candidates in Finland: A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position.

Only for candidates in Sweden: For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

The administrator of your personal data is: Nordea Bank Abp operating in Poland through its Branch, address: Aleja Edwarda Rydza Śmiglego 20, 93-281 Łodź.
