Title: Staff Fullstack Data Analyst (Commercial Analytics)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note:

Applications will be open until 2nd October 2026 at 10.00 CEST.

We will not review any application before the closing window so, please, don't rush to apply and ensure you use the time to submit a high quality, personalised application.

About The Role

Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine — acquisition, retention, propensity modelling, and customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Staff Full Stack Data Analyst, you are the senior technical voice for commercial analytics at Pleo. You set the architectural direction for Growth Intelligence's analytics layer, define what good looks like for the team, and shape how GTM data is structured, governed, and consumed by people and increasingly by AI tools.

You bring technical depth, commercial instinct, and organisational reach in equal measure. You move between architecture reviews and executive presentations, between defining metric contracts and mentoring the analysts who implement them. You don't just answer questions - you identify the right ones, and you make sure the answers compound over time.

Who you'll work with

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner closely with senior commercial leadership, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams; the onboarding and self-serve product teams; Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers across the broader data organization; and Data Services & Governance on standards and semantic layer ownership. You will be a visible, senior presence across the entire data community at Pleo.

What you'll be doing


Own the architectural direction of the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention. You'll be making systemic decisions about how models are structured, layered, and governed, not just what gets built next.
Identify and resolve upstream data quality issues at source, treating quality gaps as governance and contract problems, articulating the business risk they create, and driving the org-level changes needed to fix them durably.
Define canonical GTM metric definitions in the semantic layer, in partnership with Data Services & Governance while ensuring RevOps, CS, CX, BI tools, and AI tooling are working from the same source of truth, and holding that standard over time.
Partner with senior commercial leadership to shape the questions worth answering.
Lead in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns.
Design and govern the team's approach to experimentation ensuring statistical rigour, scalable methodology, and clear criteria for what constitutes a meaningful result.
Build analytics explicitly architected for self-serve and AI access: structured, documented, and reliable enough for business teams, conversational analytics tools, and AI features to consume autonomously.
Mentor and develop analysts on the team through code reviews, design discussions, and deliberate knowledge-sharing, raising the collective standard of analytical craft.
Contribute to engineering and analytical standards across the broader data community, participating in cross-team reviews and helping define what production-grade analytics looks like at Pleo.


For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally.

What you bring


Prior experience operating at Staff or Lead level in data analytics or analytics engineering roles in a fast-paced SaaS organisation.
Expert knowledge of SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested, well-architected models and can make and defend layering decisions for a team, not just yourself.
Solid proficiency with Python for data analysis and manipulation.
Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.
BigQuery fluency, including performance optimization and cost considerations at scale.
Mastery of a modern BI tool such as Looker or Omni.
Commercial specialisation: you have worked in a commercial analytics focused role and understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle economics, and how data connects to revenue outcomes at a strategic level.
Systems thinking on data quality: you approach quality gaps as governance questions, identify root causes upstream, and drive fixes that last rather than patches that don't.
Strong understanding of data contracts: schema ownership, SLAs, and the organizational dynamics required to make producer-consumer agreements stick.
Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and you know why metric consistency becomes critical as AI tooling scales.
Track record of advising senior GTM stakeholders around shaping the question as much as answering it, and communicating risk and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders.
Experience mentoring analysts and raising team capability


Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You excel at turning large, interconnected and complex problems into well structured, clearly defined and pragmatic solutions. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity within a fast-paced SaaS organisation, and can generate clarity, you'll find this role very exciting.
You find hands-on technical work as exciting as stakeholders management, delivery management and governance strategy.
You have operated as a Technical Lead for Commercial / Growth Analytics within a 500+ people SaaS organisation and understand the recurring topics, challenges and goals businesses of our scale experience.


This role is NOT a good fit for you if:


You prefer to specialise deeply in one technical area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between architecture, analysis, experimentation, stakeholder management, and mentoring.
You are not comfortable operating at senior leadership level and shaping ambiguous commercial questions into solvable data problems. You'll often need to define what success looks like before you can measure it.
You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex: definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires organisational negotiation as much as analysis.
You think of standards and governance as someone else's job. At this level, you are part of how the organisation decides what good looks like.


How you'll develop in this role


By the end of your first six months, you will have left the analytics layer in structurally better shape, not just fixed individual dashboards, but addressed the underlying quality, governance, and architectural gaps that were causing repeated pain for RevOps, CS, and CX teams.
You will have driven at least one meaningful governance outcome: canonical GTM metric definitions agreed with Data Services & Governance, embedded in the semantic layer, and actively used so that analysts, BI tools, and AI features are working from the same numbers.
You will have established yourself as a trusted partner to commercial leadership, not just the person who delivers the analysis, but the person they bring in when they're not sure what question to ask.
You will have shipped something that changed what was possible: not improved plumbing, but unlocked a capability or decision that couldn't have happened without you.


Show Me The Benefits


Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Core skills test: an async technical exercise designed to assess your coding fundamentals.
Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute experience-based interview to deep dive into your domain knowledge, technical expertise and ability to lead initiatives.
Pleo Challenge: a live practical and technical case study designed to assess your domain knowledge, problem solving, and insights generation skills.
Final interview: a 30-minute conversation with a senior leader focusing on your behavioural skills.


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
For this role, technical experience, seniority and commercial domain expertise all matter equally. Ensure your CV reflects the actual experience you have in each of these areas.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Senior Model Validation Quant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you an engineer with a solid quantitative foundation, or a quantitative analyst with interest in modern software development and engineering discipline? Join Credit Risk Model Validation at Danske Bank and help us build the most technologically advanced, automated credit model risk management department in the Nordics.

In Credit Risk Model Validation (CRMV), we are reimagining how model risk is managed across Danske Bank. We are moving away from manual data wrangling, ad-hoc scripts, and copied notebooks towards an industrialised, reproducible, and AI-accelerated quantitative engineering ecosystem. In this role you will bridge the traditional divide between quantitative model validation and software engineering, with your initial focus being roughly 70% tooling and infrastructure engineering and 30% direct model validation.

You will be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team operating on a modern stack: migrating to GitHub Enterprise Cloud and Databricks, building modular internal Python packages, configuring Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), setting up GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, and embedding GitHub Copilot as a standard daily partner in engineering.

This position can be located in Vilnius, Lithuania or Copenhagen, Denmark. The relocation package isn't applicable for this role.

What You Will Be Doing


Build and evolve validation software: design, implement, and maintain core Python packages and shared libraries that turn complex quantitative methodologies into clean, parameter-driven, and testable tools.
Architect modern workflows & infrastructure: set up and manage GitHub Actions workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) to ensure seamless, automated, and audit-ready execution across environments.
Empower and enable the department: create the tooling and automated templates that allow fellow validators to run analyses, generate standard evidence bundles, and produce publication-ready PDF reports with minimal manual friction.
Perform and lead model validations: apply your quantitative insight to independently validate credit risk models (such as PD, LGD, CF, IFRS 9, etc.), assessing conceptual soundness, statistical performance, and model limitations.
Integrate AI-assisted engineering: make heavy daily use of GitHub Copilot to accelerate code delivery, write thorough test suites, and modernise legacy codebases.
Promote engineering excellence: champion version control hygiene, structured code reviews, and reproducible analytical practices across the entire team.
Engage key stakeholders: present technical architectures, quantitative findings, and validation conclusions clearly and persuasively to model developers, risk leaders, and regulatory counterparts.


About You


Quantitative grounding: you hold an MSc, PhD, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Quantitative Finance, Data Science, or Engineering).
Strong software and coding habits: you have solid hands-on experience writing clean, modular Python and SQL.
Collaborative version control (Git is a must): you are completely at home with Git branching strategies, pull requests, automated checks, and collaborative code reviews are second nature to you.
Infrastructure & automation mindset: you have practical experience with (or a strong appetite to master) modern platforms like Databricks (including DABs) and GitHub Actions.
Enthusiasm for AI tooling: you are excited to leverage GitHub Copilot daily to supercharge your workflow (prior experience is a plus, but curiosity and openness to AI-assisted coding are what count).
The bridge-builder mindset: you enjoy the intersection of quantitative modelling and software craftsmanship, and you are comfortable switching between building infrastructure and digging into model mechanics.
Clear communicator: you communicate with clarity and warmth in English, translating technical and mathematical nuances into straightforward insights for diverse colleagues.


What We Offer You

If based in Lithuania, the monthly salary range would be from 3280 EUR to 4920 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (benefits are only valid for Lithuania the same as the salary ranges) which includes:


Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.
Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.
Hybrid working conditions: home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.
Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.
Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.


See all the benefits HERE.

Your title in job contract will be Risk Methodology & Model Validation.

If you're interested in this role and joining my team, feel free to contact me – Linas Smalakys, Head of Credit Risk Model Validation 3 via Linkedin and I will answer your questions!

Role: Associate Data Analyst

Locations: Copenhagen, Denmark | Hybrid 6 days a month







The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Associate Data Analyst to join our Copenhagen office and become part of a specialised, collaborative, and close-knit team working at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and securities litigation.

As an Associate, you will contribute to a broad range of research and analytical activities, including evaluating securities class actions, estimating potential investor recoveries, analysing settlement opportunities, and supporting the identification and assessment of new business opportunities.

The position combines financial analysis, data analysis, litigation research, and business research. You will work with financial and trading data, legal and regulatory filings, institutional investor information, and internal analytical models to support the evaluation of complex litigation matters.

You will be given hands-on responsibility from an early stage and gain broad exposure to securities markets, institutional investors, class action litigation, and data-driven financial analysis.




What You Will Get To Do:

Assist with the calculation and analysis of potential damages and settlement recoveries in securities class actions, including securities fraud, IPO, merger, and other shareholder litigation matters.
Collect, validate, and analyse financial, trading, market, and litigation data used in case evaluations and recovery estimates.
Conduct research on securities class actions, court filings, settlement notices, regulatory filings, and relevant market developments.
Review legal filings and settlement documentation to identify class definitions, relevant securities, eligibility requirements, and potential recovery opportunities.
Assist with research and analysis of institutional investors and prospective clients, including their investment strategies, portfolio holdings, SEC filings, assets under management, and potential exposure to litigation opportunities.
Support the development and maintenance of financial, statistical, and predictive models used to evaluate potential litigation outcomes, damages, and recoveries.
Support the preparation and maintenance of loss estimates, price-drop analyses, case valuations, and other internal and client-facing analytics.
Maintain and update internal databases and analytical tools relating to pending litigation, settlements, and institutional investors.
Prepare tables, charts, calculations, and other analytical materials using Microsoft Excel and other data-analysis tools.
Perform ad hoc financial, litigation, and business research as required.
Contribute to the continued development and improvement of research processes, analytical methodologies, databases, and internal tools.




What You Will Bring:

We are looking for a candidate with a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in working with financial information and complex datasets.

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Law, or another relevant field.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience working with data and the ability to analyse and interpret complex datasets.
Strong research skills and the ability to collect, evaluate, and combine information from multiple sources.
Excellent attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
The ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
A proactive approach, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn.




The following would be an advantage but is not required:

Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data-analysis or statistical software.
Experience in financial analysis, investment research, data analytics, business research, or a related area.
Familiarity with SEC filings, including Forms 13F, 13D, and 13G.
Knowledge of securities markets, institutional investment management, or financial instruments.
Experience working with large financial or transactional datasets.
An interest in securities litigation, class actions, or litigation analytics.




Why You Will Love It Here!

Title: Datakonsulent til Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus (SDCA) - Innovation (1-årigt barselsvikariat), Aarhus Universitetshospital
Description:
Datakonsulent til Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus (SDCA) - Innovation (1-årigt barselsvikariat), Aarhus Universitetshospital,

Brænder du for at arbejde med sundhedsdata tæt på klinisk praksis, innovation og forskning? Og vil du være med til at omsætte data til løsninger, der bidrager til udvikling af diabetesområdet - både gennem dataleverancer til innovations- og forskningsprojekter og gennem udvikling af nye dataværktøjer til klinisk praksis?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til en stilling som datakonsulent ved SDCA Innovation - et 1-årigt barselsvikariat pr. 1. december 2026. Der kan eventuelt senere være mulighed for forlængelse. Du bliver en del af et lille hold med hhv. en datamanager og en data scientist, der har indgående kendskab til data inden for diabetesområdet og til sundheds- og BI-data i Region Midtjylland.

Hvem er vi?

SDCA er Region Midtjyllands kraftcenter på diabetesområdet og en organisation, hvor der er plads til udvikling, nysgerrighed og nye idéer. I stillingen bliver du en del af SDCA Innovation, en tværfaglig enhed med 25 medarbejdere, der arbejder med innovations- og designprocesser, digital udvikling, sundhedsdata, læring, adfærdsdesign, projektstyring og implementeringsstøtte.

Sammen med forskere og klinikere arbejder SDCA Innovation med at drive nyskabelse, implementering og udbredelse af nye løsninger, der skaber viden og værdi i praksis – både for personer med diabetes og for sundhedsvæsenet generelt.

Om stillingen

Som datakonsulent bliver du en central del af arbejdet med at skabe datadrevet indsigt og beslutningsstøtte på diabetesområdet. Du kommer både til at bidrage til innovationsprojekter, forskningsprojekter og udvikling af dataværktøjer, der understøtter klinisk praksis, kvalitetsudvikling og ledelsesbeslutninger. Stillingen spænder bredt, og du vil arbejde med hele processen fra afdækning af databehov, datastrukturering og -træk til visualisering og formidling af resultater.

For kandidater med interesse for data science vil der desuden være mulighed for at bidrage til projekter, hvor vi undersøger anvendelsen af AI- og machine learning-metoder på kliniske og driftsgenererede data.

Dine konkrete opgaver vil bestå af


opbygning af kendskab til datalandskabet i Region Midtjylland (BI-data), herunder korrekt databasehåndtering med henblik på dataleverancer og rådgivning
datamanagement i form af afklaring, strukturering og validering af sundhedsdata til brug i forbindelse med innovations- og kvalitetsudviklingsprojekter
udarbejdelse af visualiseringer, der understøtter behovsafdækning, projektudvikling, evaluering og beslutningstagning i innovationsprojekter og kvalitetsudvikling
dialog med klinikere, forskere, projektledere og andre interessenter om databehov, datakvalitet og fortolkning af data
udvikling af dashboards, datavisninger og dataværktøjer til sundhedsprofessionelle og ledelse på tværs af hospitalerne og på sigt også tværsektorielt
levering af data fra Region Midtjyllands datavarehus til større forskningsprojekter på diabetesområdet.


For kandidater med interesse for data science kan opgaverne desuden omfatte


bidrag til udvikling og validering af AI/ML løsninger på kliniske og driftsgenererede data
vurdering af klinisk anvendelighed og implementeringsmuligheder for datadrevne AI/ML beslutningsstøtteløsninger
deltagelse i netværk inden for AI, data science og digital sundhed.


Vi forventer af dig, at du


har erfaring i programmering (SQL og evt. R, Python el.lign)
kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
har gode kommunikations- og formidlingsevner og kan oversætte viden om data til kollegaer med andre fagligheder
kan arbejde team-orienteret og indgå i et tæt samarbejde, hvor man arbejder fleksibelt og integreret og hjælper hinanden i den daglige opgaveløsning
har en kandidatgrad inden for f.eks. sundhedsteknologi, folkesundhedsvidenskab, informationsvidenskab eller lignende.


Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har


erfaring med arbejde i sundhedssektoren
erfaring med Tableau, Power BI eller lignende visualiseringsværktøjer
kendskab til data governance, datakvalitet eller datamodellering
interesse og kendskab for AI og machine learning.


Vi kan tilbyde dig


et bredt arbejdsfællesskab med engagerede og tværfaglige kollegaer
at blive en del af en velfungerende enhed med et godt kollegialt og socialt sammenhold
en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at definere og udvikle dine opgaver
et job med stor mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling i en dynamisk organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og mulighed for selv at præge egne arbejdsopgaver.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte innovationschef Katrine Holm Lindgaard på tlf. 2370 7067 eller på mail katrln@rm.dk

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 14. oktober 2026 og vi forventer at holde samtaler d. 21. og 22. oktober 2026.

Om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus

Vi tror på, at alle mennesker kan få et godt liv. Et liv fyldt med glæde, livskvalitet og mulighed for at træffe egne frie valg.

Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus er Region Midtjyllands udviklingscenter på diabetesområdet. Vi arbejder for, at mennesker med diabetes kan leve et godt liv - og knække kurven, så færre mennesker får diabetes. Vi udvikler og samarbejder om nye og innovative diabetesindsatser inden for behandling, forebyggelse, forskning og tværsektorielt samarbejde. I særlig grad til gavn for alle, som er påvirket af diabetes, men i høj grad også til gavn for det samlede danske sundhedsvæsen.

Vi er drevet og ejet af Region Midtjylland, støttet af en 10-årig bevilling fra Novo Nordisk Fonden og er fysisk placeret på Aarhus Universitetshospital.


Mød nogle af dine måske kommende kolleger.
Læs mere om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus.
Følg os på LinkedIn.


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret til samtale.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk.

Title: Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.




We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.




The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.




This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.




So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.




Responsibilities

Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.
Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.
Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.
Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.
Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.




Who are you?

You have:

Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.
Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.
Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.
Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.
Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.




What We Offer

Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.
Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.
Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.
Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.
Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

Title: Vil du hjælpe os med at udvikle FREMTIDENS KVÆGAVL?
Description:
Brænder du for data og statistik, og synes du koen er et fantastisk dyr? Vil du være med til at udvikle et mere bæredygtigt kvægbrug i Danmark? Så er du måske den kollega, vi leder efter til et spændende job i SEGES Innovation.




I SEGES Innovation tilbyder vi dig en karriere med mening. Vores innovation og viden gør en forskel både i hverdagen og på den lange bane. Vores specialister arbejder med alt fra klima og miljø, planter, dyr og digitale løsninger til vækst og vidensformidling. Sammen bidrager vi til de løsninger, der gør landbruget og fødevareproduktionen endnu mere bæredygtig.




I afdelingen for Husdyr søger vi lige nu en person med en uddannelse inden for agrobiologi, statistik, matematik, data science eller lignende. Din uddannelsesbaggrund er dog ikke det vigtigste. Det vigtigste er, at du har stærke analytiske evner, interesse for data og lyst til at være med til at udvikle grundlaget for avlsarbejdet med kvæg i Danmark og Norden.




Hvad skal du lave?

Som vores nye kollega bliver du en del af den afdeling, der har ansvar for udvikling og drift af avlsværdivurdering for malkekvæg, kødkvæg, får og geder. Vi er ni personer, der arbejder tæt sammen om alt fra indsamling af data på den enkelte ko til implementering af avancerede statistiske modeller. Du får ansvar for konkrete opgaver og projekter, men vi bruger aktivt hinandens viden og kompetencer. Vi har nemlig som regel travlt, og vores erfaring er, at vi når længst gennem samarbejde.




Dit arbejdsområde vil primært være udviklingsprojekter, hvor vi udvikler de avlsværdital, som landmænd og avlsorganisationer bruger til at vælge de bedste avlsdyr som forældre til næste generation. Det kan for eksempel være avlsværdital for reduceret metanudledning eller egenskaber, der forbedrer dyrevelfærd og sygdomsresistens. Grundlaget er store mængder data fra blandt andet genomiske tests og målinger på køer og kalve.




Noget af det, vi selv synes er allerbedst ved vores arbejde, er muligheden for at være med til at forme fremtidens projekter og faglige fokusområder. Derfor er opsamling, udvikling og prioritering af nye idéer en vigtig del af vores hverdag. Samtidig motiverer det os at se, at det vi udvikler, bliver anvendt i praksis hos landmændene og gør en reel forskel.




En typisk hverdag

Vi er praktiske talnørder, og vores projekter har typisk en varighed på 1 til 4 år. En normal arbejdsdag starter ofte med statistiske analyser eller udviklingsopgaver. Vi arbejder tæt sammen som gruppe og har faste morgenmøder tre gange om ugen, hvor vi kort deler status på vores opgaver og eventuelle udfordringer.




Selvom du har dine egne ansvarsområder, er der altid en erfaren kollega at sparre med, og Teams bliver flittigt brugt til både store og små spørgsmål i løbet af dagen. Efterhånden som du opbygger erfaring, vil du også få dialog med avlsrådgivere og landmænd samt mulighed for at præsentere resultater og anbefalinger.




Du får dermed en varieret hverdag med mulighed for både fordybelse, faglig udvikling og samarbejde.




Projektporteføljen for 2026 og 2027 er allerede fastlagt, men vi har gode muligheder for at tilpasse dele af opgaverne efter dine interesser og kompetencer.




Vi drømmer om, at du

Har lyst til at analysere store datasæt.
Har lyst til at udvikle nye idéer og eventuelt lede udviklingsprojekter.
Kan kommunikere klart og præcist, både mundtligt og skriftligt.
Kan programmere i SAS eller Python eller har lyst til at lære det.
Har interesse for dataanalyse og lyst til at lære mere om kvægproduktion og avl.




Det får du hos os

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø med mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for statistiske modeller, programmering, projektledelse og formidling af komplekse analyser.




Når du starter, har vi en plan klar for både din introduktion til gruppens arbejde og dine første opgaver på kort og længere sigt. Du får tilknyttet en kollega, som sikrer, at du kommer godt i gang.




Har du ikke et indgående kendskab til kvæg, er det ikke noget problem. Vi hjælper dig med at opbygge den nødvendige forståelse, og hvis du har lyst, sender vi dig gerne på besøg i en besætning, så du får et godt indblik i branchen og de problemstillinger, vi arbejder med.




Praktiske oplysninger

Ansættelse ønskes snarest muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Anders Fogh på telefon 51 73 73 23.




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde en ny kollega velkommen i arbejdet med at udvikle fremtidens bæredygtige kvægbrug.










Ved rekruttering hos SEGES Innovation prioriterer vi primært din faglige ekspertise og personlighed. Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke, derfor opfordres alle med de rette kompetencer til at søge - uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, kønsidentitet og alder.




SEGES Innovation er en uafhængig forsknings- og innovationsvirksomhed, der arbejder for en bæredygtig og konkurrencedygtig landbrugs- og fødevareproduktion. Vi kobler faglige indsigter med digitale teknologier, så ny viden kommer ud at virke i stalden, på marken og i hele værdikæden fra jord til bord.




Vores mange forskellige eksperter udgør et unikt fagmiljø i international topklasse med ca. 500 dedikerede kolleger, der arbejder ud fra værdierne Mod, Hjerte og Dybde og i tæt samspil med Danmarks mere end 30.000 landbrug, universiteter og uddannelsesinstitutioner, landbrugsrådgivere, fødevareproducenter, energiselskaber og myndigheder.

Title: Postdoc in Multi-Modal Behavioural Modelling - DTU Compute
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

If you are looking to establish yourself as a researcher in the cross-disciplinary fields of machine learning and mental health, this postdoc position is for you.

At DTU Compute you will focus is on building multi modal models for mental health applications in a Danish context. You will collaborate with a mental health department at the hospital (Region H), startup companies, as well as Denmark’s AI research and development house, Alexandra Instituttet. Our joint grand solution project is providing foundational models (wearables, speech, video) for behavioural modelling across several mental health applications.

Responsibilities And Qualifications

As part of the position, you will be responsible for:


Data collection activities
Data annotation activities
Developing novel models for multi modalities, herein wearables, speech, and/or video
Pursuing the aims of making foundation models more representative.
Modelling data from mental health applications in collaboration with mental health experts
Conducting computational research experiments and disseminating these in research papers
Good collaborations with project partners (incl. hospitals and companies)


We are looking for you with


Outstanding interdisciplinary collaboration skills
Good organizational/project management skills
Excellent research skills in machine learning and an
Interest in mental health applications


As a formal qualification, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent).

We offer

DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and terms of employment

The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures .

The period of employment is 22 months. Start date is according to mutual agreement. The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here .

Further information

Further information may be obtained from Line Clemmensen, Lkhc@dtu.dk .

You can read more about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk .

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark .

Application procedure

Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 12 October 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:


Application (cover letter)
CV
Academic Diplomas (MSc/PhD – in English)
List of publications


Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Our research is rooted in basic research and centres on mathematical models of the physical and virtual world, as a basis for the analysis, design, and implementation of complex systems. We focus on ensuring that our research results contribute to creating a better society by supporting areas such as health, green transition, energy supply, and life science. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance. Read more here: www.compute.dtu.dk .

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829

DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

Job Description

The Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) opens a 4 year full time position for an experienced scientist to work with satellite and in-situ observations to assess the suitability of hybrid-ML/AI and end-to-end data-driven methods to replace classical (physics based) methods in the production of future reanalyses (e.g. ERA7)

Most of the work is carried out in the Horizon Europe project, CHERRI, led by European Center for Medium Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF). DMI has a task in the project to lead the activities about evaluating atmospheric reanalysis systems with a particular focus on oceans and the high latitudes, including ice sheets and sea ice. It is expected that you will be the technical and scientific lead on these activities that include developing a system which enables easy assessment of various NWP reanalysis products and on interpreting on the results to provide feedback to the model developers in CHERRI. DMI is a leading European developer and producer of remote sensing products, including surface temperature products for the global ocean and high latitudes, sea ice concentration and emissivity products for the Polar Oceans and you will use these products in the assessment.

In addition, you will participate in the work within the Copernicus Marine Service and the Copernicus Climate Change projects to produce operational and timely updates of the satellite surface temperature products.

You will work in close collaboration with dedicated and highly qualified colleagues in the remote sensing group and colleagues from other institutions across Europe and you will be writing peer reviewed publications and representing DMI in new research projects and in international organizations.

Main working tasks


Lead the tehnical and scientific development within the HEU CHERRI WP 9 “Work on NWP reanalysis model evaluation and diagnostics”
Develop diagnostics to assess the ability of hybrid-ML and end-to-end data-driven analysis methods to produce physically consistent earth-system states and trends.
Lead the communication and reporting to the project on the evaluation and diagnostics.
Develop and implement a processing code base that will enable multi model validation and intercomparison with satellite products, with focus on oceans and high latitudes.
Contribute to Copernicus Marine and C3S data processing
Represent DMI within the international science community through participation in international collaborations and contribute to new satellite missions.


Your Qualifications


Recognized scientist with expertise on NWP/Reanalysis evaluation.
Experience working with satellite observations.
Experience with physical ocean and sea ice processes.
Good communication skills and a scientific publication list.
Advanced programming skills in e.g. Python (preferrable) orFortran .
Experience with Linux and GIT
Good skills in oral and written English.
Can work well in a team in close collaboration with your colleagues.


The position is in the Danish National Centre for Climate Research (NCKF) at DMI, which employs approximately 80 scientists of which 20 are located in the Satellites and Arctic unit. We have a strong international profile which is also reflected in the many nationalities here and in an English "working language".

Employment and Salary

Will be according to the Danish Law and Agreements, specifically the Collective Agreement for State-Employed Academics (AC-overenskomsten). It will be possible to negotiate an addition to the basic salary depending on your qualifications and experience. DMI offers a flexible working week of 37 hours including a paid lunch break, and six weeks of paid vacation annually. If you come from abroad, there is a possibility for a reduced tax scheme the first 7 years.

For further details about the position, contact the head of the unit NCKF-Satellite and the Arctic: Jacob L. Høyer (telephone: +45 29 31 87 95 or by e-mail: jlh@dmi.dk).

At DMI, diversity is an important value for us, because we believe that an inclusive and versatile work environment strengthens task fulfilment. We work actively with diversity in our employee composition, which is reflected in our inclusive workplace with a balance between work life and family life. We encourage everyone to apply for the position regardless of age, gender, sexuality, religion or ethnicity.

How to apply

Title: Data AI Engineer (AI & Analytics)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Building trusted AI-powered analytics for healthcare training outcomes




Make an impact with Laerdal!

Laerdal Medical is a world leader in healthcare education and resuscitation training that uses immersive technologies and data-centric insights to increase survival and improve healthcare quality. Laerdal Copenhagen is our Center of excellence for Digital Learning, and on a global scale, we work with leading life-saving institutions around the world including emergency services, hospitals, ambulance services, first aid organizations, and educational institutions. Our products help these organizations save lives every day. We are a dynamic and energetic organization consisting of people from a wide variety of cultures and backgrounds. Our goal is to help save one million more lives, every year, by 2030, and to do so sustainably.




Position overview

We work in the space of advanced analytics for learners in healthcare and are looking to expand our team. In our area of Resuscitation Quality Improvement (RQI) we serve as the interface for varying roles in the healthcare system that want to know how their learners are doing, where they can improve and how prioritizing a high-quality training curriculum elevates the skills of their workforce.




Our product team spans multiple roles, backgrounds and nationalities and for the next major phase in how we deliver insights to users, we want your help:

Do you understand how to translate a vast structured data foundation into actionable insights for different user groups and metrics?

Do you have experience in advanced analytics, i.e. leveraging LLMs, statistics and ML? Have you implemented agentic systems? Do you know how to move from product idea to trustworthy user-facing feature in this space?

Do you want to help us on our mission to help save (even more) lives?




If you answered YES to those questions, don’t hesitate to apply with a brief personal motivation and CV and we might soon be getting to know each other in person!




What we want to build with you:

AI-Ready data foundation: guaranteeing high data quality for AI, refining the data model and ensuring efficient retrieval/search across our domain
Agentic data analyst: empower our analytics users to uncover individualized insights by combining traditional analytics with agentic workloads.
Operational excellence for AI: continuously learning and adapting the system while collaborating closely with product and design experts on the team




How you will contribute to the team:

Design and implement agentic product features for our custom advanced analytics platform
Understand and improve our domain data model
Partner with the Product Manager and Design Researcher to understand user needs, gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Ensure security/compliance and governed access for customers and internal users as well as safe guardrails for AI




Which skills you should bring (AI & data):

Hands-on experience in data modeling, production ready LLM solutions and using tools such as Langchain, Mastra, Embabel or other ADKs
Proficiency in using cloud data platforms and corresponding tools; e.g. PySpark, SQL, Databricks as well as the tools that enable search indexes, RAG or other integration patterns
Proven understanding of different agent workflow patterns and their benefits
(optional) Experience in data governance, semantic models and metadata management




Software engineering & other skills:

Knowledge of engineering practices and willingness to discuss them with peers; e.g. branching strategies, TDD, agile & DevOps principles
Advanced abilities in AI coding: harness engineering, skills development, context engineering, etc.
(optional) Knowledge in IaC tools and cloud solution architecture
(optional) Domain knowledge in healthcare and/or learning systems




Why join Laerdal Copenhagen?

Join a mission-driven team where your work helps improve healthcare and save lives around the world. You'll enjoy a high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment that values autonomy, collaboration, craftsmanship, and continuous learning. Our Copenhagen office, located in a historic warehouse in the city center, combines an ambitious, international culture with a relaxed atmosphere, great colleagues, and flexible working conditions. We are currently counting 160 colleagues in Copenhagen – a mix of talents across engineering, design, learning- and medical specialists, working in cross functional teams. As part of Laerdal Medical, you'll work locally with a talented team while being connected to a global organization of 2,200+ people dedicated to helping save one million more lives, every year, by 2030.




Learn more about our mission: One Million More Lives

Or get a glimpse of our office culture: Laerdal Copenhagen 2022 | Videos & Movies on Vimeo




Interested?

Apply with your CV and a short motivation explaining why this role speaks to you. (Remember, LinkedIn allows only one document, so please merge your CV and motivation letter into one file.)




If you have any questions that might keep you from applying, reach out by e-mail to Engineering Manager Jasper Hahn Jasper.Hahn@laerdal.com.




We’ll review applications and set up interviews on an ongoing basis.

Title: Specialkonsulent indenfor statistik til Dansk Center for Sundhedstjenesteforskning
Description:
Ved Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet, Klinisk Institut, Aalborg Universitet er en stilling som specialkonsulent indenfor statistik ledig til besættelse pr. 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter. Stillingen er tidsbegrænset til 31. januar 2029 og på 37 timer pr. uge (100% ansættelsesgrad). Stillingen er knyttet til etableringen af et nyt forskningsmiljø indenfor implementeringsvidenskab.



Dine arbejdsopgaver



At rådgive om, planlægge, udføre samt dokumentere statistiske analyser ifm. projekter i tilknytning til Dansk Center for Sundhedstjenesteforskning og samarbejdspartnere. At deltage aktivt i vidensopbygning i centret bl.a. gennem faglig sparring med forskere og ph.d.-studerende. At indgå i og videreudvikle centerets internationale samarbejdsrelationer. At løbende styrke sin faglige profil, bl.a. gennem deltagelse i konferencer og workshops inden for både statistisk metode, forecasting og centerets genstandsfelt, samt gennem deltagelse i vidensdeling på tværs af centrene ved Klinisk Institut.



Dine kompetencer



Stillingen forudsætter en kandidatgrad i statistik, matematik, ingeniørvidenskab, datalogi, bioinformatik eller lignende, gerne kombineret med solid erhvervserfaring inden for bioinformatik, biostatistik, forecasting og evt. epidemiologi. Vi søger en kandidat med programmeringserfaring (Python, R, MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL, C++, etc.), herunder erfaring med R-shiny. Det vil være en fordel med erfaring med statistisk metodeudvikling samt anvendelse af nye statistiske og bioinformatiske metoder i komplekse sundhedsvidenskabelige problemstillinger. Erfaring med rådgivning og vejledning af lægevidenskabeligt personale samt erfaring med publicering i sundhedsvidenskabelige samt statistiske tidsskrifter vil blive vægtet højt.



Stillingen indebærer udadvendte aktiviteter, inkl. rejseaktivitet i forbindelse med møder og konferencer. Det er ligeledes en forudsætning at ansøger har stærke skriftlige formuleringsevner (dansk og engelsk) samt besidder evnen til at skabe og indgå i et personligt og fagligt udviklende miljø for såvel kolleger som for sig selv. Generelt vægtes gode samarbejdsevner og evnen til at kunne indgå i et tværfagligt team højt. Det forventes at kandidaten kan arbejde parallelt og selvstændigt på flere projekter ad gangen. Omstillingsparathed og evnen til at levere til tiden er centralt for rollen. Vi arbejder i et åbent forskningsmiljø, hvor kode, afrapportering og grafiske fremstillinger dokumenteres og deles med de øvrige deltagere i hvert enkelt projekt samt med de øvrige medarbejdere tilknyttet enheden.



Hvem er vi



Klinisk Institut leverer forskningsbaseret undervisning til alle fagområder på den lægevidenskabelige kandidatuddannelse, og bedriver forskning inden for de kliniske specialer. Klinisk Institut arbejder tæt sammen med de nordjyske hospitaler og almen praksis om undervisning og forskning. Der foregår undervisning af medicinstuderende på flere hospitalsmatrikler og i almen praksis i Region Nordjylland.



Instituttet har tilknyttet cirka 40 forskningsenheder med hvert sit lægefaglige speciale. Ud over disse forskningsenheder har instituttet tilknyttet en række andre forskningsenheder og centre. Hovedparten af instituttets personale har, ud over ansættelsen på instituttet, samtidig en hospitalsansættelse.



Læs mere om Klinisk Institut her.



Stillingen er tilknyttet Dansk Center for Sundhedstjenesteforskning. Centret er et missionsdrevet, multidisciplinært forskningscenter, som rummer klinisk, epidemiologisk, statistisk, sundhedsøkonomisk og sociologisk ekspertise. Missionen er at bidrage til bedre kvalitet i sundhedsvæsenet. Centret får som led i Sundhedsreformen fra 2027 status som nationalt center for sundhedstjenesteforskning. Centret har aktuelt ca. 45 ansatte og tilknyttede forskere.



Ansøgning 



Din ansøgning skal indeholde følgende:  

Ansøgning, hvori du redegør for, hvilke faglige og personlige kompetencer samt erfaringer der gør dig særligt kvalificeret til stillingen 
CV 
Eksamensbevis 
Evt. relevante bilag 

Du kan læse mere om krav til din ansøgning her. 



Ansøgning sendes via Aalborg Universitets rekrutteringssystem, som kan tilgås under stillingsopslaget på Aalborg Universitets hjemmeside. 



Aalborg Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og har diversitet som en kerneværdi. Derfor opfordres alle uanset personlig baggrund og orientering til at søge stillingen.



Har du spørgsmål?



Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:



Centerleder, klinisk professor Søren Paaske Johnsen, e-mail: spj@dcm.aau.dk



Seniorstatistiker Jan Valentin, e-mail: jvalentin@dcm.aau.dk.



Øvrige informationer 



Du kan læse mere om vores rekrutteringsproces her. 



Ansættelsesprocessen på Aalborg Universitet kan omfatte en risikovurdering som et værktøj til at identificere potentielle risici forbundet med nyansættelser, der sikrer arbejdspladsens sikkerhed, compliance og integritet. 



Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår



Du ansættes og aflønnes efter overenskomsten for akademikere i staten med indplacering som specialkonsulent. Der er mulighed for forhandling af kvalifikationstillæg.



Du kan læse om lønnen og lønsammensætningen for stillingen i Lønoverblik i forbindelse med rekruttering - Akademiske (AC-TAP). Se det indledende afsnit på siden samt afsnittet ”Specialkonsulent”.



Der er 3 måneders gensidig prøvetid i stillingen.



Aalborg Universitet - Viden for verden



Aalborg Universitet er en international arbejdsplads med mere end 3700 ansatte. Vi udbyder virkelighedsnære uddannelser og skaber forskningsresultater i verdensklasse gennem samarbejde mellem forskere, studerende og offentlige og private virksomheder. Sådan opnås erkendelser, nye løsninger på samfundets problemer og viden, der forandrer verden. Vores hovedcampus ligger i Aalborg, men vi har også campus i Esbjerg og København.

At rådgive om, planlægge, udføre samt dokumentere statistiske analyser ifm. projekter i tilknytning til Dansk Center for Sundhedstjenesteforskning og samarbejdspartnere. At deltage aktivt i vidensopbygning i centret bl.a. gennem faglig sparring med forskere og ph.d.-studerende. At indgå i og videreudvikle centerets internationale samarbejdsrelationer. At løbende styrke sin faglige profil, bl.a. gennem deltagelse i konferencer og workshops inden for både statistisk metode, forecasting og centerets genstandsfelt, samt gennem deltagelse i vidensdeling på tværs af centrene ved Klinisk Institut.

Dine kompetencer

Stillingen forudsætter en kandidatgrad i statistik, matematik, ingeniørvidenskab, datalogi, bioinformatik eller lignende, gerne kombineret med solid erhvervserfaring inden for bioinformatik, biostatistik, forecasting og evt. epidemiologi. Vi søger en kandidat med programmeringserfaring (Python, R, MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL, C++, etc.), herunder erfaring med R-shiny. Det vil være en fordel med erfaring med statistisk metodeudvikling samt anvendelse af nye statistiske og bioinformatiske metoder i komplekse sundhedsvidenskabelige problemstillinger. Erfaring med rådgivning og vejledning af lægevidenskabeligt personale samt erfaring med publicering i sundhedsvidenskabelige samt statistiske tidsskrifter vil blive vægtet højt.

Stillingen indebærer udadvendte aktiviteter, inkl. rejseaktivitet i forbindelse med møder og konferencer. Det er ligeledes en forudsætning at ansøger har stærke skriftlige formuleringsevner (dansk og engelsk) samt besidder evnen til at skabe og indgå i et personligt og fagligt udviklende miljø for såvel kolleger som for sig selv. Generelt vægtes gode samarbejdsevner og evnen til at kunne indgå i et tværfagligt team højt. Det forventes at kandidaten kan arbejde parallelt og selvstændigt på flere projekter ad gangen. Omstillingsparathed og evnen til at levere til tiden er centralt for rollen. Vi arbejder i et åbent forskningsmiljø, hvor kode, afrapportering og grafiske fremstillinger dokumenteres og deles med de øvrige deltagere i hvert enkelt projekt samt med de øvrige medarbejdere tilknyttet enheden.

Hvem er vi

Klinisk Institut leverer forskningsbaseret undervisning til alle fagområder på den lægevidenskabelige kandidatuddannelse, og bedriver forskning inden for de kliniske specialer. Klinisk Institut arbejder tæt sammen med de nordjyske hospitaler og almen praksis om undervisning og forskning. Der foregår undervisning af medicinstuderende på flere hospitalsmatrikler og i almen praksis i Region Nordjylland.

Instituttet har tilknyttet cirka 40 forskningsenheder med hvert sit lægefaglige speciale. Ud over disse forskningsenheder har instituttet tilknyttet en række andre forskningsenheder og centre. Hovedparten af instituttets personale har, ud over ansættelsen på instituttet, samtidig en hospitalsansættelse.

Læs mere om Klinisk Institut her.

Stillingen er tilknyttet Dansk Center for Sundhedstjenesteforskning. Centret er et missionsdrevet, multidisciplinært forskningscenter, som rummer klinisk, epidemiologisk, statistisk, sundhedsøkonomisk og sociologisk ekspertise. Missionen er at bidrage til bedre kvalitet i sundhedsvæsenet. Centret får som led i Sundhedsreformen fra 2027 status som nationalt center for sundhedstjenesteforskning. Centret har aktuelt ca. 45 ansatte og tilknyttede forskere.

Ansøgning 

Din ansøgning skal indeholde følgende:  

  • Ansøgning, hvori du redegør for, hvilke faglige og personlige kompetencer samt erfaringer der gør dig særligt kvalificeret til stillingen 
  • CV 
  • Eksamensbevis 
  • Evt. relevante bilag 

Du kan læse mere om krav til din ansøgning her. 

Ansøgning sendes via Aalborg Universitets rekrutteringssystem, som kan tilgås under stillingsopslaget på Aalborg Universitets hjemmeside. 

Aalborg Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og har diversitet som en kerneværdi. Derfor opfordres alle uanset personlig baggrund og orientering til at søge stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål?

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Centerleder, klinisk professor Søren Paaske Johnsen, e-mail: spj@dcm.aau.dk

Seniorstatistiker Jan Valentin, e-mail: jvalentin@dcm.aau.dk.

Øvrige informationer 

Du kan læse mere om vores rekrutteringsproces her. 

Ansættelsesprocessen på Aalborg Universitet kan omfatte en risikovurdering som et værktøj til at identificere potentielle risici forbundet med nyansættelser, der sikrer arbejdspladsens sikkerhed, compliance og integritet. 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes og aflønnes efter overenskomsten for akademikere i staten med indplacering som specialkonsulent. Der er mulighed for forhandling af kvalifikationstillæg.

Du kan læse om lønnen og lønsammensætningen for stillingen i Lønoverblik i forbindelse med rekruttering - Akademiske (AC-TAP). Se det indledende afsnit på siden samt afsnittet ”Specialkonsulent”.

Der er 3 måneders gensidig prøvetid i stillingen.

Aalborg Universitet er en international arbejdsplads med mere end 3700 ansatte. Vi udbyder virkelighedsnære uddannelser og skaber forskningsresultater i verdensklasse gennem samarbejde mellem forskere, studerende og offentlige og private virksomheder. Title: AI Developer, NewTech - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
What if you could help companies transform their businesses using AI, machine learning and data? Joining KPMG as an AI Developer means you’ll be working with a variety of clients, applying the latest AI models and leveraging the power of data to optimize operations, enhance customer experience and predict future trends. Take on exciting challenges from day one and shape the future of AI.

About The Role

As an AI Developer in NewTech, you will have the opportunity to develop solutions with the latest AI tools and work with real-world applications that create measurable business value. You will work with both classical machine learning and modern LLM-based solutions, helping clients transform data into intelligent automation and decision support. You will collaborate closely with consultants, data specialists and client stakeholders, gaining experience across the full lifecycle of AI solution development from experimentation to production-ready deployment.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:


Develop and deploy machine learning and LLM-based applications that automate processes and extract insights from complex data.
Design and implement scalable AI solutions following best practices within MLOps, DevOps and DataOps.
Work with modern AI frameworks, tools and cloud platforms to build production-grade applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.
Contribute to shaping how organizations adopt and scale AI capabilities.


Perks of joining NewTech

At KPMG NewTech, we work at the intersection of business, technology, and implementation. What makes our team different is that we do not only advise clients on transformation – we help design, build, and implement solutions together with them. Our projects combine emerging technologies, automation, AI, and organizational change, meaning you will collaborate closely with colleagues across business, and technical disciplines while helping clients turn ideas into practical solutions. 

Our team brings together consultants, engineers, data scientists and developers who collaborate closely across projects. Working alongside both junior and senior colleagues, you will gain exposure to different perspectives and contribute to solving complex client challenges.

What sets NewTech apart is our practical focus on consulting by doing. From early on, you will be involved in shaping solutions, testing technologies, and working directly with clients to support adoption, and value realization. Many join NewTech because they want to work with emerging technologies while staying close to real business challenges, and enjoy working across strategy, implementation, and organizational transformation.

About You, Our New Team Member

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:


Has solid technical skills in leveraging machine learning and LLM models, with a solid understanding of algorithms and data structures.
Has experience with frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, Hugging Face, LangChain, DataBricks, MLFlow, FastAPI, MCP or similar is key and you are skilled in optimizing models for performance, scalability and interpretability.
Is familiar with cloud platforms, data pipelines and version control using Git, allowing you to integrate models into production seamlessly.
Above all, you’re interested in AI’s transformative potential and are keen to stay at the cutting edge of a field that changes almost daily.
Communicates confidently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.


KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:


Describe a project (academic, personal, or professional) where you applied machine learning or AI to solve a real problem. What was the problem, what approach did you take and what did you learn?
Imagine you need to explain the value of a machine learning/ AI solution to a non-technical client. How would you do it?
Why are you interested in an AI Developer role at this stage of your career and what skills or areas are you most excited to develop?


If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Mårten Waldmann Lauridsen mwaldmann@kpmg.com .

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!
